findings.issue: Masculine singular adjective חזק is rendered as the reflexive gerund fortaleciéndose, adding an inchoative process and a reflexive actor the adjective does not license.
Common noun שופר is left as the Hebrew loan shofar; uncertain whether that loan is already the Spanish common noun.
Qal participle הולך predicates the voice (קול) with ויהי, but andante placed after shofar can be read as modifying the horn.
Piel imperfect ידבר and qal imperfect יעננו are smoothed to Spanish present habla and responde.

notes: Construct קול, Moisés, Dios for אלהים, the 3ms suffix, and בקול are licensed.
